name: Peony's Eternity
source:
A flower swept from its field loses its petals as its life hangs on a thread. Passing royalty finds itself mystified, coveting the uniqueness of the ephemeral flower. 

“What kind of being so reliant on its petals would allow them to be tarnished to such a pitiful state?”

Without realizing it, royalty falls willingly for the tattered flower’s allure, leaving nothing but the crown for the plant to take. But was the crown something desired, or was it simply a flight of fancy that wove shackles of fate around the flower's stem? Find out in "Peony's Eternity".

[From [url=https://pissed-studios.itch.io/peonys-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一朵被从田野里扫走的花朵失去了花瓣，因为它的生命悬在一线。过往的皇室成员发现自己感到困惑，觊觎这种短暂之花的​​独特性。

“到底是什么样的人如此依赖它的花瓣，才会让它们玷污到如此可怜的地步？”

在没有意识到的情况下，皇室成员心甘情愿地被这朵破烂的花朵的魅力所吸引，除了王冠之外什么也没有留给植物。但这顶王冠到底是一种渴望，还是只是一种幻想，为花茎编织了命运的枷锁？在《牡丹的永恒》中寻找答案。

[来自[url=https://pissed-studios.itch.io/peonys-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
